high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a page from a document or article titled "A New Vision Of Nature." The text discusses the difference between two approaches to understanding cognition and consciousness: the enactive approach and the reductive view of physicalism. Title: "A New Vision Of Nature" Content: The first paragraph contrasts the enactive approach to cognition and consciousness with the reductive view of physicalism. It explains that the reductive view focuses on the brain as a physical object, asking how the movements of atoms and molecules within it create consciousness.
